_doc: Manual decisions for audit_summits.py, keyed by route_id. peak_node = OSM node id of the intended summit; peak_ele = summit elevation to use when the node has no/wrong ele; peak_names = names to match instead of the route's mountain; class = force a class (NOT_A_SUMMIT_ROUTE needs a reason); note = shown in the report.
_caveats: Track elevations of the original (phone/watch) GPX files are often 50-150 m off; the vertical test therefore also uses DEM-vs-DEM at the closest track point when the peak node's ele agrees with the DEM there.

SRTM 30 m smooths sharp summits: DEM summit heights are typically 10-60 m lower than the surveyed height, so new/replacement GPX max elevation can be below the official peak height even when the track reaches the summit marker.
Peak nodes imported from NGA-GNS (source=NGA-GNS) are frequently mislocated by hundreds of metres; they are only used when no better node exists (e.g. Gunung Watupayon, Gunung Salak Dua).

Summit access changes: Semeru (Mahameru) summit access and Anak Krakatau landings are frequently restricted by the park authorities; these routes are COMPLETE geometrically, but check current status before promoting them.

OSM data reflects what volunteers mapped; a path present in OSM is not a guarantee that the trail is open or safe. New trails were filtered for access=no and names containing Nonaktif/ditutup/tutup/closed, and Merapi summit routes were skipped.
Nothing was downloaded from community/third-party GPX sites; routes not completable from OSM are listed under 'Perlu GPX dari komunitas'.

3.note: Arjuno summit = Puncak Ogal Agil (3,339 m). The Tretes track goes to Welirang instead.

37.note: Welirang summit: OSM node 449697393 ('Arjuno-Welirang', placed on the Welirang summit; its ele tag 3339 is Arjuno's height). Welirang = 3,156 m.

78.note: Welirang summit: OSM node 449697393 ('Arjuno-Welirang', placed on the Welirang summit; its ele tag 3339 is Arjuno's height). Welirang = 3,156 m.

18.reason: passes 221 m from the Gunung Slamet node on the summit rim (DEM at the closest track point 3,343 m, above the node's DEM); the GPX elevations are ~140 m too low vs the DEM (max 3,153 m), so the vertical test fails on GPS data only. Re-elevating the file with a DEM is recommended.

53.reason: Kawah Ijen walk from Paltuding to the crater rim (~2,380 m) and the crater; the OSM 'Gunung Ijen' node sits over the crater lake and the complex's high point (Gunung Merapi, 2,799 m) is a different, rarely climbed summit.

135.reason: Sunrise View Trek is a viewpoint walk on the Ijen crater rim, not a summit climb.

75.reason: Tangkuban Parahu walk ends at the Kawah Ratu crater rim (public endpoint, ~1,890 m); the summit point (2,084 m) on the far rim is not the destination of this route.

134.reason: 'Claket - Asitaba Trail' (Pacet, Mojokerto) is a forest/village trail between Claket and Asitaba; it does not lead to a summit (nearest peak 1.5 km away, 380 m higher).

133.reason: Cisadon trail (Sentul, Bogor) is a ridge/forest traverse to the Cisadon village area, not a summit climb (OSM ways 'Cisadon Trail').

67.note: Raung true summit (Puncak Sejati, 3,332 m) = OSM node 5846266478; node 546451027 lies over the caldera (DEM 2,864 m). The Sumberwringin track ends on the eastern rim (Puncak 17/Bendera area, ~3,170 m); OSM has no path from there along the rim to Puncak Sejati.

69.note: Intended summit is Puncak Salak II (2,180 m); OSM node from NGA-GNS, DEM 2,148 m at the node.

70.note: The OSM relation 'Gunung Salak via Ajisaka' ends at Puncak Salak II (2,180 m), a recognised summit of Gunung Salak; Salak I (2,211 m) is 1.7 km further along the ridge.

101.note: Gede summit = node 'Puncak Gunung Gede'; the 'Gunung Gede' volcano node sits over the crater (DEM 2,681 m).

132.note: Destination is Gunung Watupayon (NGA-GNS node, DEM 1,495 m), not the main Muria summit.

136.note: Destination is Argo Jembangan / Punuk Sapi (1,381 m), a Muria summit.

109.note: OSM ways 'Jalur Pendakian Gunung Muria' end at Pertapaan Eyang Begawan Abiyoso (1,233 m); nearest Muria summit on that ridge is Puncak Natas Angin (1,515 m).

104.note: Possible duplicate: every point of this track lies on route 56 (same trailhead -7.77942,111.71704; it is the outbound half of route 56's round trip).

56.note: Route 104 (via Kare) is the same path (outbound half of this round trip).

28.note: Original is a Linggarjati -> Palutungan traverse; the replacement is the Linggarjati ascent to the summit only (Palutungan is route 6).

130.note: Track ends at Puncak Ismoyo (1,740 m); the OSM paths near the Telomoyo summit are not connected to it in the OSM path/footway/track network.
